description: This Java source file defines the ScreenCaptureFragment class, which provides a user interface and logic for performing screen capture functionality within an Android application. It manages media projection setup, virtual display creation, surface handling, and user interaction for starting and stopping screen recording.

classes.name: ScreenCaptureFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages UI and logic for capturing the device screen using MediaProjection API. Handles lifecycle events, user interactions, permissions, and manages virtual display and surface setup for screen recording.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restoring saved state related to screen capture result if available.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's UI layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components such as SurfaceView and Button, sets click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves display metrics and initializes MediaProjectionManager.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current screen capture result data for configuration changes.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle button click to start or stop screen capture.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the screen capture permission prompt, sets up media projection and virtual display.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops screen capture when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media projection resources upon fragment destruction.

methods.name: setUpMediaProjection
methods.description: Initializes MediaProjection instance using the result data.

methods.name: startScreenCapture
methods.description: Initiates screen capture process, requesting permission if necessary.

methods.name: setUpVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Creates a VirtualDisplay for the screen content, linking it to the SurfaceView surface.

methods.name: stopScreenCapture
methods.description: Releases the VirtualDisplay and updates UI to reflect capture has stopped.
